div.head: IV Eg 1.1
div.ab: Gif geneatmanna hwylc forgymeleasað his hlafordes gafol ⁊ hit him to ðæm rihtandagan ne gelæst, wen is, gif se hlaford mildheort bið, þæt he þa gymeleaste to forgyfnysse læte ⁊ to his gafole buton witnunge fó;

Gif geneatmanna hwylc forgymeleasað his hlafordes gafol ⁊ hit him to ðæm rihtandagan ne gelæst, wen is, gyf se hlaford mildheort bið, þæt he ða gymeleaste to forgyfenesse læte ⁊ to his gafole buton witnunge fó;

Ut, si quis in seculo militans debitum domini sui pensum census neglexerit, neque illud diebus statutis, quos preterire non licet, persoluere studuerit, putandum est, ut, si idem dominus pius et misericors extiterit, eandem relaxans neglegentiam, ueniam tribuit et sine aliqua ultione quod suum rite uidetur ab eo suscepit;

Gif geneatmanna hwylc forgymeleasað his hlafordes gafol ⁊ hit him to ðæm rihtandagan ne gelæst, wen is, gyf se hlaford mildheort bið, þæt he ða gymeleaste to forgyfenesse læte ⁊ to his gafole buton witnunge fó.

Wenn einer der Hintersassen [eines Grossguts] die Abgabe für seinen Herrn versäumt und sie ihm nicht zum richtigen Termin leistet, so ist Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass, wenn der Herr barmherzig ist, dieser jene Versäumniss zur Verzeihung zulasse und die ihm [gebührende] Abgabe ergreife ohne [weitere] Bestrafung;

If one of the tenants [of a great estate] neglects his lord's rent and does not pay it to him by the proper day, it is likely that, if the lord is merciful, he will allow that negligence to be forgiven and take the rent [due] to him without [further] punishment;

If any tenant neglects the payment due to his lord and does not render it to him on the appointed day, it is to be expected that, if the lord is merciful, he will grant forgiveness for the neglect and take his payment without exacting a penalty.

If any tenant disregards the rent to his lord, and does not pay it to him at the appointed day, it is to be expected, if the lord is merciful, that he may forgive the neglect and take his rent without exacting a penalty.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Bauer 9h; Gerichtsbarkeit 15. Es ist nicht erlaubt, dieses harte Los des säumigen Zahlers zu erklären, indem man ihn zum Unfreien macht (mit Seebohm Engl. Dorfgem. 97). Vielmehr der Besitzer eines Hofs in dem vom Herrschaftsgute (s. d. Gl 1 B) abhängigen Dorfe ist gemeint; s. Einl. 11.—Die Versio kam auf seculo vielleicht aus woruld der vorigen Zeile, meint aber jedenfalls keinen Unfreien, ja sogar vielleicht einen höheren Stand als Eadgar, nämlich den ritterlichen Mann vom Gefolgsadel (s. d. Gl 2. g. h), welche Bedeutung geneat ursprünglich hatte

Cf. Gl Bauer 9h; Gerichtsbarkeit 15. It is not permissible to explain this harsh fate of the defaulting payer by making him an unfree man (with Seebohm Engl. Dorfgem. 97). Rather, what is meant is the holder of a farm in the village dependent on the manor (see that word in Gl 1 B); see Introduction 11.—The Versio arrived at seculo perhaps from woruld in the preceding line, but in any case means no unfree man, indeed perhaps even a higher rank than Eadgar does, namely the knightly man of the nobility of the retinue (see that word in Gl 2. g. h), which was the original meaning of geneat
Nicht Pacht (s. d. Gl), sondern Abgabe (s. d. Gl 7) an die Grundherrschaft
Not rent (see that word in Gl), but a due (see that word in Gl 7) to the lord of the manor
= ‘die Versäumnis verzeiht’; vgl. let gebod (geþeaht) to gemeleaste (zitiert von Toller 613a II): ‘vernachlässigt Gebot (Beschluss)’
= ‘forgives the default’; cf. let gebod (geþeaht) to gemeleaste (cited by Toller 613a II): ‘neglects a command (resolution)’
Cf. II Edg. 1, 1 and note. The Latin version (derived from C) translates militans, i.e. it takes geneat in its earlier sense. The translation seems to be inexact in many points.
